brief: Holds a performance tuning plan as proposed actions that only an effectful actor may commit, with every outcome audited.
detail: Optimization crosses reality: scaling a fleet, draining workers, healing the dead. Expression is free and admission is governed. The plan's catalog is closed: ScaleUp, ScaleDown and RestartDead, each mapping to one verb on the target. An actor whose effects are empty, such as an inference-only LLMActor, can build the plan, explain it and hand it over, but ExecuteOn refuses it wholesale and audits each refusal; a HumanActor commits. MayCommit answers admissibility before any attempt. The audit trail holds [ n, verdict, action, tag, actor, why ] for every outcome, so refusals are never silent.
receiver:
o1 = StzPerfPlan("relieve-nlp")
o1.Propose(:ScaleUp, "nlp", "measured load 0.92 > high-water 0.75")
o1.Propose(:RestartDead, "nlp", "2 dead workers")
oAdvisor = LLMActor("advisor")
oChief = HumanActor("mansour")
